book.title: WAI PII EPE MAKEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Akali Kingi Yangi Talyanga Mende Tolasakamaiyamo Doko
Jisasa baa dee lotuu anda dokonya peamopa, andakote dokonya akali kingi yangi talyanga mende petea.
Peteamopa, Parasi dupame Jisasa-kisa tenge setamana lao masetala, Sambata gii dokonya kingi talyanga doko baame tolasakamailyape lao kandakondape petae peteami.
Dokopa Jisasame kingi talyanga doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Emba sakatatala, endakali pitakanya enombanya kalya ipu”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Loome aipa lapae singi? Sambata gii dokonya kalai epe pipengepe, pande koo pipenge? Endakali nisepengepe, pande endakali pyao kumasepengepe?”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa, dokaita ema napyoo
mona kana jiaminosa, Jisasame imbu kaeyao dokaita kandayoko latala, akali doko lamaiyoo,
lea. Dokopa baanya kingi doko tinokeamopa, kingi doko auu petala kingi yangi epe dopaleaka jia.
Dopa piamopa, Parasipi, Kiŋi Erote tatapi, dupame Jisasa aipa petala pyao kumasemape lao yapa kamaka kolalyetala kambuiyami.
Endakali Kambu Andake Mendeme Jisasa Watao Peamino Doko

Dopa piaminopa, Jisasa baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa yuu doko yakinatala, Galali pete dokonya peaminopa, Galali tange kambu andake mendeme baa watao peami. Dokopa Jisasame pilyamo lapae dupa sepala, Judia tangepi, Jerusalema tangepi, Idumia tangepi, endaki Jodane omotena tangepi, Taeyapa Saidonepa dolaponya makisa dosa tangepi, longo mendapu baa katea dokonya epeami.

Wamba baame endakali yaina pyapae longo mee jakamaiya dokonya, endakali yaina pyapae epeami dupa pitakame baa watandamana latala, tuu-tuu lao baa katao tambukinalanya piami. Dopa piaminosa, endakali kambu andake dokome baa katao tambukinala naena lao, sipi yakane mende disaipolo dupame depa lekena lea.
Imambu koo dupame baa kandeamili pyoo, baa katea dosa ipao tombauli sepala puu lao, lao pituu, “Emba Gote Ikiningina” lata piami.
Dokopa imambu koo dupame Jisasa baa akali dokona lao, lao panala naena lao kyeto joo pyalanya lea.
12 Aposole Dutupa
Jisasa baa lalyoo yuu manda mendenya pupala, akali mendatupa baa watao epena lao masia dutupa epena leamopa, dokaita baa katea dokonya epeami.

Epeami dupanya akali 12 baa-pipa katamana lao yapao nyia. Yaina mee jingi dokopa, imambu koo dupa watao pingi dokopa, dolaponya kyeto doko dutupa maitala, wai pii epe doko lamaiya pena laanya yapao nyia.
Yapao nyepala, Saimone baa kenge enenge Pita lea.
Sebedi ikiningi Jemesapa, Jemesa kaiminingi Jonepa dolapo kenge Bonagesa lea. (Bonagesa dokonya tenge doko, Kaiti toka lenge dokonya ikiningi.)
Andruapi, Pilipapi, Batalomyuapi, Matyuapi, Tomasapi, Alopiusa ikiningi Jemesa lenge dokopi, Tadiusapi, Kena tange Saimone lenge dokopi,

yandapipi dupanya kinginya Jisasa maiya akali Judasa Iskariota lenge dokopi, dutupa apata baame yapao nyiaka. Jisasa-Kisa Belesabulu Palelyamo Leamino Doko Yapao nyepeamopa, dokaita anda mendenya peami.
Dokopa endakali dupa dee ipao kambu piaminosa, baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa Jisasa baa nee napenge nanjia.
Endakali dupame lao pituu, “Baa kyakelyamona” leami. Dopa leami doko baanya tata dupame sepala, baa kii minao lanyala epeami.

Epeaminopa Mosesanya loo mana nyepae, Jerusalema katao lanao epeami dupame lao pituu, “Baa-kisa Belesabulu palelyamona” leami. “Imambu koo dupanya isingi dokonya pupu lapae dokome imambu koo dupa baame watao pilyamona” leamiaka.
Dopa leaminopa, baame dokaita epena latala kongalimi lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Sataneme Satane yango aipa petala watao pyata?
Isa yuu dakenya kingdom mendenya endakali dupa pyaloo petala wakale pitamino doko, kingdom doko kyeto joo naseta.
Anda mendenya palenge dupa pyaloo pitamino doko, dokaita kyeto joo nakatatamiaka.
Dopaka pyoo, Satane baa tange wakale pyaloo petala, yanda pingi-tamo doko, baa kyeto joo nakatenya, baa etata.
Akali mendeme akali pupu lapae mendenya andaka kolandatala, baanya pinju dupa pake nyalanya-tamo doko, wambao kendeme baa yaki pinya setapala pinju dupa nyeta.
“Nambame nyakama kiningi langilyo: Endakali dupanya koo pingipi, lao nepengepi dupa pitaka Goteme kunao nepakamaita.
Dopaka doko, Oli Spirita doko lao nepata endakali dokonya koo doko Goteme kunao nepakamaiya naeyatamopa, tanga tangapi sulu setana”

content: lea.
Jisasa-kisa imambu koo mende palelyamona leaminosa, baame dopa lea.
Jisasanya Endangipi Kaiminingipi Dupa Dupana Leamo Doko
Dokopa Jisasanya endangi dokopi, kaiminingipi dupa ipao katapala, baa kamaka epena lao endakali mendeme lanyala pena leami.
Dokopa Jisasa pituu kakopeami endakali kambu dupame Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Embanya endangi dokopi, kaiminingipi, pimalengepi dupame emba kutao ipupala kamaka kalyaminona” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo,
lea.
Dopa latala baa pituu kakopeami dupa kandayoko latala lao pituu,

content.text: “Endakali pilyamino dakaita nambanya endangipi, kaiminingipina kanjepa.
Gotenya masingili pingima endakali dupa nambanya kaiminingipi, pimalengepi, endangipina”

content: lea.
